title.narrative: Program to Strengthen Civil Service Management in the Dominican Republic
Programa de Fortalecimiento de Gestin del Servicio Civil de la Repblica Dominicana

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es mejorar la eficiencia del sector pblico de la Repblica Dominicana mediante el fortalecimiento de la capacidad institucional del Ministerio de Administracin Pblica en materia de: (i) gestin de recursos humanos y salarios; (ii) optimizacin de tecnologas de informacin y comunicacin (TIC); y (iii) mejora de la participacin ciudadana y rendicin de cuentas.

The general objective of the program is to improve public sector efficiency in the Dominican Republic by strengthening the institutional capacity of the Ministry of Public Administration through the following: (i) strengthening the management of human resources and wages; (ii) optimization of information and communication technologies (ICT), and (iii) improvement of citizens' participation and accountability.
